releases.name: Version 1.6.2
releases.bodyZh: Xenのプルリクエストを受け入れました。

releases.name: Version 1.6.1
releases.body: Hotfix for Gabbro and Solanum's conversations.
releases.bodyZh: GabbroとSolanumの会話のホットフィックス。

releases.name: Version 1.6.0
releases.body:
- Talk to Gabbro about all the fun ways you've died!
- Tell people Feldspar is alive!
- Some small fixes.
- The secret interaction with Solanum should now work as intended.
releases.bodyZh:
- ガブロ (Gabbro) に、君がどれだけ面白い方法で死んだかについて話してみよう！
- フェルスパー (Feldspar) が生きていると人に言ってみよう！
- いくつかの小さな修正。
- ソラヌム (Solanum) との秘密のインタラクションは、今や意図通りに動作するはずです。

releases.name: Version 1.5.0
releases.body:
- Add dialogue for the probe passing by Chert
- Tell Riebeck about the writing on Hollow's Lantern
- Tell Riebeck you've gone through the black hole at the center of Brittle Hollow
- Add dialogue for if your ship is busted, you can tell someone you're stuck on the planet
- Tell Chert about the Stranger
- A mystery thing
releases.bodyZh:
- Chertを通過する探査機のセリフを追加
- Riebeckに空洞のランタンの書き物について教える
- Riebeckに脆い空洞の中心にあるブラックホールを通り抜けたことを教える
- 船が壊れた場合、誰かに惑星に閉じ込まれていることを伝えるセリフを追加
- ChertにStrangerについて教える
- 不明なもの

releases.name: Version 1.4.0
releases.body:
- Added hug dialogue at ENDGAME LOCATION.
- Code now uses ReuseDialogueOptionsListFrom
- As per the usual, probably a ton of other stuff I forget is new to this version
- This will maybe be the last release for a little bit

releases.name: Version 1.3.1
releases.body: Hotfix for hug mod dialogue. Should now go away after speaking once, as intended.

releases.name: Version 1.3.0
releases.body:
- Hug mod compat!
- Cowering should be a-okay now!
- Bad mallow dialogue. Wait, was that already in the last release?
- Astral Codec dialogue that should hopefully work!
- Other stuff. Look, I'm not keeping track.

releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
The Campfire Dialogue Update:
- Dialogue for burning yourself at people's campfires.
- Mod compatibility!
- So much other stuff I forgot.
